'''menace64 The BEST LS Endor Deck! DS will be up soon!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[menace64]]
* '''Published:''' 7 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 RST menace64 LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

the title speaks for itself....

The published list has 63 cards.
